findings.highlight: spent the whole day making the gem sword
findings.evidenceJa: 宝石剣とやらの型どりに終始し
findings.governingReading: Rin spends the day wholly occupied with shaping or taking the form of the jeweled sword.
findings.explanation: The English presents the weapon as being made rather than preserving the incomplete shaping stage.

findings.highlight: The shadow should go into action soon
findings.evidenceJa: 今までの例から言って、あの“黒い影”が動き出すのはそろそろだろう
findings.governingReading: Judging from the previous cases, Shirou expects the shadow will probably become active soon.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the prediction but removes its evidentiary basis.

findings.highlight: I can’t even see Sakura’s face
findings.evidenceJa: どんな顔をしているのかさえ把握できない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot make out what expression the sleeping Sakura is wearing.
findings.explanation: The English changes an inability to apprehend her expression into literal inability to see her face.

findings.governingReading: Even during this interval, the shadow may be attacking people in town.
findings.explanation: The English interprets the passage of time as Shirou’s hesitation.

findings.highlight: there’s no way to directly kill it
findings.evidenceJa: あの影を倒す手段がない
findings.governingReading: Shirou has no means to defeat the shadow directly.
findings.explanation: The English narrows defeat into killing even though the shadow’s ontological status is unresolved.

findings.highlight: Sakura will commit crimes she does not want to commit
findings.evidenceJa: 望まないまま、罪を犯してしまった桜自身も
findings.governingReading: Sakura herself has already ended up committing the act or sin unwillingly and is among those harmed.
findings.explanation: The English changes completed reluctant culpability into a prediction of multiple future crimes.

findings.highlight: It’s like stumbling and falling eye-first onto a flathead screwdriver
findings.evidenceJa: うっかり地面から飛び出していたマイナスドライバーに眼球からつっこむような感じ
findings.governingReading: The imagined fall is onto a flathead screwdriver accidentally protruding from the ground.
findings.explanation: The English removes the bizarre ground-protrusion detail that makes the aversion image so physically specific.

findings.evidenceJa: 失明しかねない麻痺痛
findings.governingReading: The numbing pain seems capable of causing blindness.
findings.explanation: The English promotes possible blindness into an intrinsic quality of the pain.

findings.highlight: look as if they’re all bending in the wrong way
findings.evidenceJa: 不思議な力で反対方向に折り曲げられていくように見える
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s fingers seem to be bent backward by a mysterious force.
findings.explanation: The English retains abnormal bending but removes the apparent external force that motivates the psychic-power comparison.
